name: cog-second-brain
description: Self-evolving second brain with 33 AI skills, 10 agents, and people CRM. Closed-loop harness release: V-model verification lifecycle with criterion-traced evidence, read-only verifier agents, risk lanes, multi-session ultragoals with a north-star acceptance gate, craft skills for writing and visuals, and paired anti-slop design skills for marketing and product UI. Inspired by Garry Tan's gstack and gbrain, and dwarves-kit. Works with Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, Kiro, Gemini CLI, Codex.
